title: FRB/US Model: Large-Scale Macroeconomic Model of the United States
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
credibility_notes: Authoritative US central bank macroeconomic general equilibrium model documentation
bias_and_limitations: Focuses on US national accounts and policy analysis; requires structural parameter calibration

title: The FRB/US Model: A Tool for Macroeconomic Policy Analysis
publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
credibility_notes: Official description of monetary policy transmission channels and expectations formation
bias_and_limitations: Emphasizes linearized policy reaction rules and historical VAR priors

title: Money Creation in the Modern Economy
product_version_or_tier: Bank of England Quarterly Bulletin 2014 Q1
credibility_notes: Authoritative central bank refutation of the money multiplier myth and proof of endogenous money creation
bias_and_limitations: Focuses on commercial banking mechanics; does not model shadow banking in depth

title: The Transmission of Monetary Policy through the Financial System
credibility_notes: In-depth cross-country empirical analysis of banking balance sheets and policy rate passthrough
bias_and_limitations: Aggregates diverse national banking systems which vary in capital regulation stringency

title: Monetary Economics: An Integrated Approach to Credit Money Income Production and Wealth
credibility_notes: Foundational treatise on stock-flow consistent macroeconomic modeling and balance sheet conservation
bias_and_limitations: Post-Keynesian framework rejects rational expectations in favor of accounting identities and heuristics

title: Stock-Flow Consistent Macroeconomic Models: A Survey
publisher: European Journal of Economics and Economic Policies
credibility_notes: Rigorous taxonomy of SFC models and their transaction-flow matrix specifications
bias_and_limitations: Primarily academic literature review without client-side software implementation benchmarks

title: How The Economic Machine Works
credibility_notes: Widely acclaimed systemic template breaking the economy into transactions short-term and long-term debt cycles
bias_and_limitations: Simplified intuitive framework; lacks explicit mathematical differential equations

title: FRED Economic Data & Educational Simulation Tools
publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
independence_group: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
credibility_notes: Standard global benchmark for economic time series Taylor rule benchmarks and economic indicators
bias_and_limitations: Presents empirical historical observations rather than counterfactual interactive simulations

title: Brilliant Interactive Learning Platform Architecture
credibility_notes: Pioneering pedagogical design benchmark for interactive visual first-principles learning
bias_and_limitations: Focuses on STEM concepts; limited built-in macroeconomic or monetary system courses

title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
credibility_notes: International normative technical standard for web accessibility conformance
bias_and_limitations: General web specification; requires specialized interpretation for canvas and animated SVG simulations

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 Systems and Software Engineering Requirements Engineering
author_or_owner: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 7 Software and Systems Engineering
credibility_notes: Definitive global standard for unambiguous verifiable and testable software requirements specification
